name: external-link
description: An arrow leaving a rounded open window toward the upper right in a square frame.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Open window centerline bounds 7.5..16.5, radius 1.5. Upper arm stops at (10,7.5), right arm at (16.5,14), leaving clear space for a separate outbound arrow. Arrow runs (11.5,12.5) to (16.5,7.5); head arms are (13,7.5) to the tip to (16.5,11). Filled uses exact radius-.875 window expansion (corner radii 2.375/.625), and an analytically unioned shaft and solid triangular head rotated -45 degrees. The default visible bounds are 6.625..17.375, centered on both axes. Window-to-head gaps are 1.25px at Regular and .5px at Bold. Conservative Circle clearance exceeds .26px at Bold. All None/Square/Circle forms use the identical native glyph position and size, without per-frame transforms. Outline defaults to Regular 1.75 with round caps/joins, Thin 1.25 and Bold 2.50. Standard frame exteriors span 2..22, with Square radius 4 and Circle radius 10; Outline frame centerlines span 2.875..21.125 with corner radius 3.125 / Circle radius 9.125. Framed Filled subtracts the exact standalone Filled silhouette as transparent negative space. Original project geometry; no third-party SVG paths used. All forms remain drafts pending owner review.

review.note: New window action icon and frame variants; awaits owner review.
